description: This file defines the backend code for the UserProfile web page in an online exam system. It handles loading user data from a SQL Server database using session information, and provides navigation handlers for different pages like Dashboard, Leaderboard, and Login.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: ASP.NET Page class for user profile management in the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, retrieves user information from database if session exists, and updates UI fields.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handler for profile button; currently commented out.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and redirects to login page.
